imbalance_experiment.justification: Tie within tolerance (tol=0.0020): Unweighted ('none') Macro-F1=0.9518, Hybrid SMOTE ('smote') Macro-F1=0.9518 fall within 0.0020 of peak validation Macro-F1=0.9518 (gap=0.0000 vs 'smote'); tie within tolerance, simplest strategy selected -> 'none' (Weighted-F1=0.9989, Macro-Recall=0.9323, mlogloss=0.0046; Hybrid SMOTE ('smote') Macro-F1=0.9518 (Weighted-F1=0.9989, mlogloss=0.0044); Class-Weight ('class_weight') Macro-F1=0.9446 (Weighted-F1=0.9981, mlogloss=0.0092)).

xgboost_optimization.selection_note: No meaningful improvement: Optuna tuned val Macro-F1 (0.9563) changed by +0.0059 vs baseline (0.9504), within baseline CV std=0.0121; retaining baseline.
xgboost_optimization.cv_method_note: Unified 5-fold StratifiedKFold on the development pool (162,577 rows = train+val, held-out test excluded) with per-fold preprocessing and 'none' imbalance handling (sample ddof=1 std across folds).

hardware.notes: TensorFlow GPU not available on native Windows (>=2.11 CPU-only) or no CUDA runtime; using CPU. XGBoost CUDA acceleration verified and enabled.

ensemble_analysis.honest_verdict: Ensemble fusion 'stacking' (Test Macro-F1=0.9606) is comparable to XGBoost, difference not statistically significant (XGBoost=0.9603; observed delta=+0.0003, paired bootstrap n=1000 mean diff=+0.0004, 95% CI=[-0.0069, +0.0086] includes 0; statistically_significant=False). Standalone XGBoost is kept as the supervised default with the Autoencoder orthogonal.

anomaly_detector_comparison.verdict: Best binary F1 at 95th-pct threshold: One-Class SVM (F1=0.5898, Recall=0.5117, FPR=0.0504); best overall ROC-AUC ranking: LOF (ROC-AUC=0.8607). Autoencoder achieved F1=0.5881 / ROC-AUC=0.8384, confirming it works best as a supplementary anomaly signal alongside supervised XGBoost rather than as a standalone detector.

unseen_attack_protocol.scientific_note: Experimental novelty-detection protocol: the supervised classifier cannot assign a label to 'Web Attack' when omitted from training (0.0% class recall), whereas the benign-only Autoencoder evaluates structural divergence from learned benign normality via reconstruction MSE.

by_day_protocol.caveat_note: In CICIDS2017, all attack families occurring on Thursday and Friday (Bot, DDoS, Infiltration, PortScan, Web Attack) are absent from Monday-Wednesday training data. Closed-set multi-class Macro-F1 therefore cannot attribute unseen Thursday-Friday labels, whereas the Cross-Day Binary table evaluates Benign-vs-Attack generalization directly.
